cells.judge_note: This profile keeps the speaker's order and words: it removes what speech leaves behind and punctuates. Content moved out of its place counts as a finding only when the move changes the meaning.

This profile keeps the speaker's order and words but recomposes broken sentences into written ones and cuts paragraphs at changes of subject. Recomposition inside a sentence is normal cleaning; content moved out of its place counts as a finding only when the move changes the meaning.

This profile regroups the speech by theme on purpose: paragraphs are reordered and sentences said in different places are gathered under the theme they belong to. A change of order or grouping is never a finding. Judge only whether the content, the terms, the direction of each statement and the hedges survived the regrouping.
